prompt: Create a flowchart for a user login process: user enters credentials, system validates, if valid go to dashboard, if invalid show error and retry

assertions.name: valid_json
assertions.description: Output file parses as valid JSON

assertions.name: valid_excalidraw_structure
assertions.description: Has type='excalidraw', version=2, and elements array

assertions.name: bidirectional_bindings
assertions.description: Every arrow binding has a matching boundElements entry on the target shape, and vice versa

assertions.name: has_decision_diamond
assertions.description: Contains at least one diamond element for the validation branching decision

assertions.name: minimum_element_count
assertions.description: Has at least 5 shape/text elements representing the flowchart nodes (start, input, validate, dashboard, error)

assertions.name: has_arrows
assertions.description: Contains arrow elements connecting the flow nodes

assertions.name: no_overlapping_shapes
assertions.description: No two non-text shape elements occupy the exact same x,y position
